snippet.title: S.M.P.C.U. | Prototype Footage
snippet.description:
Welcome to S.M.P.C.U. (Special Monster Pest Control Unit) our horror coop game! 

Make sure to check our discord: https://discord.gg/QDw9FvPa5B 
for more updates and previews!

---
In S.M.P.C.U. you are part of a special kind of pest control unit. Your task: Remove extraterrestrial monsters that have infested the pantries of fast-food restaurants. 

Your team must search the pantry for the monster and locate the portal through which it came. Since the monster can’t be killed, the goal is to seal the portal to trap the monster inside. Your company will take care of the rest. 

But be careful: Don't disturb the monster sleeping near the portal!
---

Keep in mind that this is still early prototype footage and things are subject to change!
